q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close. Today is August 23, 2026. **Time remaining: ~3 days.**

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided official guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue: **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.**

This means the official guidance range is $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion. The company issued this guidance when reporting Q1 FY2027 results, and the earnings release on August 26 will confirm, reaffirm, or adjust this forward guidance.

**Most likely outcome:** The guidance will remain at or very close to $91.0 billion (±2%), as companies typically maintain their guidance unless there is a material change in business conditions. Three days is an extremely short window for fundamental business changes that would warrant guidance revision.

The guidance already reflects:
- Extraordinary growth (implying ~95% YoY growth from Q2 FY2026's $46.7B)
- Explicit exclusion of China Data Center compute revenue (reducing revenue by removing a constraint factor)
- Conservative positioning relative to Wall Street consensus ($91.9B average estimate), suggesting management confidence

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Significant deterioration in demand signals** in the 3-day window (highly unlikely)
- **Supply chain catastrophe** or manufacturing disruption (no signals in the research)
- **Major customer order cancellation** or slowdown (would require extreme circumstances)
- **Geopolitical escalation** affecting China export restrictions beyond current guidance assumptions
- Management being extremely conservative to set easy beats (possible but not typical at this stage)

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Stronger than expected customer demand** in the final days before close (possible but small window)
- **Upward revision** due to accelerating AI adoption/data center buildout (companies sometimes raise guidance if trends exceed expectations dramatically)
- **China revenue clarification** — if the company decides to include some previously excluded China revenue in guidance
- **Management deciding to reset expectations more optimistically** given the momentum in Q1 (lower probability given they just guided)

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 actual: $81.6 billion (85% YoY growth, 20% sequential growth)
- Q2 FY2027 guidance already issued: $91.0 billion ±2%
- Wall Street consensus: $91.9 billion
- Q2 FY2026 actual: $46.7 billion (for YoY comparison)

No historical base rate of NVIDIA guidance revisions is provided in the research, so I cannot cite a specific precedent. However, companies typically reaffirm near-term guidance (within 3 days of issuance) unless material changes occur.

## Analysis

The question asks what **will be** NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue in the earnings release. The guidance has **already been officially provided at $91.0 billion ±2%** according to the current research.

The earnings release in 3 days will almost certainly reaffirm this guidance. The probability of a material revision (>2% adjustment) in such a short timeframe is very low. The guidance already incorporates:
- Conservative positioning below analyst consensus
- Explicit revenue exclusions (China)
- Demonstrated strong execution (Q1 beat)

The most likely outcome is $91.0 billion ±2%, with the median point estimate at $91.0 billion.

Given the narrow window and the fact that guidance was just issued, I expect reaffirmation with high confidence. The distribution should be heavily centered on $91.0 billion with slight tails for upward or downward adjustments.

**My probability distribution:**
- 70% probability guidance stays exactly at $91.0 billion
- 15% probability minor upward revision to $91.5–$92.0 billion
- 10% probability minor downward revision to $90.5–$90.0 billion
- 5% probability larger revision (outside ±2% range)

Low (10th percentile): 89900000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 92500000000

NVIDIA is set to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).

For Q1 FY2027 (ended April 26, 2026), NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year and 20% sequentially. Data Center revenue reached $75.2 billion, up 92% year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).

NVIDIA's guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue is $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This outlook explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Wall Street analysts' average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This compares to Q2 FY2026 revenue of $46.7 billion, meaning the current guidance implies nearly doubling year-over-year [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
